Both bugs confirmed:

1. Monotonic clock goes backwards 52% of the time — 32-bit x87 80-bit excess precision. a and b print identically but the x87 register value compares *below* the caller's stored double. This is critical: every watchdog (softlock, heartbeat, map-hole fall timer) depends on this clock.
2. Scratch-dir pollution — run.jsonl/run.log from test_logger persist in the deterministic scratch dir, so test_fs counts 6 files instead of 4 on re-runs.

Fixing both:
